answer: Price entry by demand. Each new agent locks a bond that doubles for every 20 sign-ups in the past hour, so a lone newcomer pays the base rate while a burst of 200 fakes faces ten doublings: cost grows exponentially with swarm size. The live price is posted as a public beacon so nobody is surprised. Weakness: a patient attacker trickles fakes in at the base rate. Fix: bonds unlock only after 30 epochs of jury-passed work, so each trickled fake ties up capital for months and idle ones forfeit it. Standing grows like a reef, crystal by crystal.
